pages.text: The diagrams look down from the wagon’s front left. Cyan outlines mark new parts; dashed lines indicate hidden wheels on the far side.$(br2)Fit the jack, box, driver’s seat, shafts, front wheels and rear wheels in order. Each step’s right-hand page shows the result.

Leave room around the jack. Fit parts while it is $(bold)extended$(reset).$(br2)Placing a part once creates its complete multiblock component. Aim at its mounting area and leave room for the whole part.
pages.title: Before Building

pages.text: Place the jack normally to start extended. Sneak-place it to start folded; extend it before building. Wait for the animation to finish.
pages.title: Step 1: The Jack

pages.text: The extended jack supports the deck.
Use the wagon box on the jack’s $(bold)upper platform$(reset). The deck, sideboards, tailgate, footboard and boarding steps are placed together.
pages.title: Step 2: The Box

pages.text: Place the whole box at once.
Fit a driver’s seat at the front centre, above the footboard. Choose a wooden or upholstered seat to provide the driving position.
pages.title: Step 3: The Seat

pages.text: Fit the seat above the front footboard.
Fit shafts at the $(bold)front centre$(reset) of the box, below the footboard. Single shafts need one animal; double shafts need two. Hitch animals after assembly creates the wagon entity.
pages.title: Step 4: The Shafts

pages.text: The shafts project from the front.
Fit two $(bold)small wheels$(reset), one at each end of the front axle. Walk around to fit the far wheel.
pages.title: Step 5: Front Wheels

pages.text: One small wheel at each front axle end.
Fit two $(bold)large wheels$(reset), one at each end of the rear axle. Check all four wheels. You can also add optional equipment such as a cabinet, cargo cover or canopy.
pages.title: Step 6: Rear Wheels

pages.text: One large wheel at each rear axle end.

Once every required part is correctly fitted, use the jack. Its platform folds and the wagon becomes an entity immediately. Wait for the animation before using the jack again.$(br2)Follow any messages to complete missing parts. An empty jack toggles directly. Next, hitch up and board.
